authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 2867 karda gives Bengali kādā/Oriya kāda, while 2869 kardama gives Bengali/Oriya kādo and regional kādau/kādā. Eastern o-final forms select kardama; the a-final and central forms remain insufficiently diagnostic. Exact survey form kado is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6835 *dhūḍi includes Oriya dhuḷi and regional dhūl/dhūṛ dust. Simple dhuli/dhuḍ forms fit this family; reduplicated dhudhar needs separate morphology. Exact survey form dʰuli is preserved; intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
